title: János Pápai (Constantinople) to Ferenc Rákóczi II, 1706-1710 (DECODE R731, R740, R741, R757, R765, R784, R793-R796, R805, R823)

steps.what: Fetched the seven DECODE records, five transcriptions and the R731/R740 images with the project cookie.
Searched DECODE key records for NAH keys tagged Constantinople; R580 is headed 'key given to Janos Papai' (copies R581, R452).
Applied R581's table to R805: 336/336 groups give continuous Hungarian.
Applied the same table to R823, R765, R757, R741: 97.7-99.5% of groups in key.
Transcribed the numeric passage of R740 from the image (168 groups) and read it in full.
Tried to transcribe R731's six graphic-sign passages from the camera images; signs not secure enough for a solve.
Web search for a printed decipherment: Benda 1963 edition of Papai's Turkish diaries exists, contents not checked.
Catalogue target 'Unknown sender to Rakoczi II, 1707' (DECODE R784): fetched record, transcription and both images.
Scored every NAH key record on DECODE (97 transcriptions) against R784; the Constantinople key R581 (Papai's) gave running Hungarian.
Read R784 with decode.py unchanged: 587/594 groups in key; French ambassador's report on the Porte and war.
Catalogue 47 'Constantinople envoys to Rakoczi II' (DECODE R793-R796): fetched four records and transcriptions; four despatches, not two.
Applied Papai's key R581 (decode.py) unchanged: R793/R794/R796 97.4-98.0% in key; R794 and R795 signed/dated Constantinople 1706.
R795 only 83.9% in key: 251 groups 323-740. Compared with the contemporary interlinear: the decipherer skips them, so nulls.
decode_nulls.py: 5,012 of 5,043 groups read (4,706 table values + 306 nulls), 31 slips.

outcome.fraction_read_source: decode.py/decode_nulls.py over the DECODE transcriptions: 16,346 of 16,861 numeric groups have a key value, 306 more are nulls above 322 (R793-R796); R731's ~350 untranscribed signs counted unread: 16,652/~17,210.
outcome.notes: Eleven of twelve letters read with the archive key (R793-R796, catalogue 47, added); R731's graphic-sign passages not read.

gaps.item: R731 (6 Mar 1710, Belgrade), six graphic-sign passages, ~350 signs
gaps.detail: not transcribed; 2448-px images judged too poor for a secure sign transcription; the graphic-sign line on R581 not tried

gaps.item: ~209 numeric groups across R823, R765, R784, R757, R741, R793-R796
gaps.detail: digit slips, joined groups or sums in the DECODE transcriptions; not re-checked on the images

prior.where: DECODE marked R805 partly decrypted (interlinear syllables); Benda's 1963 edition of Papai's Turkish diaries not checked

human: Posed the target; supplied the DECODE session cookie earlier.
